tasks.title: FR-010 Reuse Existing Truth Tree
tasks.description: 所有生成、刷新、补齐都必须回写： `docs/beacon/<version>/prd/` `docs/beacon/<version>/user-story/` `docs/beacon/<version>/qa/test-cases/` 不得创建第二 requirement truth tree。 ## 8. 验收标准 能识别 empty / partial / full / inconsistent 状态 能输出 closure verdict 与 readiness verdict 漂移时输出 repair route reverse-derived truth 必须显式标记 不得跳过人工复核直接 promotion ## 5. 设计原则 canonical truth first no silent promotion repair before overwrite explicit verdicts over implicit state ## 6. 范围 in scope: package state detection missing-layer orchestration reverse-derived truth labeling drift repair routing out of scope: new public lifecycle stage unconditional one-shot freeze silent arbitration of conflicting truth ## 7. 验收标准 能识别 empty / partial / full / inconsistent 状态 能输出 closure verdict 与 readiness verdict 漂移时输出 repair route reverse-derived truth 必须显式标记 不得跳过人工复核直接 promotion ## 8. 风险与缓解 | 风险 | 影响 | 缓解 | | --- | --- | --- | | 把 unified entry 误解成 lifecycle 替代 | 高 | 明确 optional support boundary，保留三层 truth 结构 | | 下游反推上游导致错误 truth 升格 | 高 | 强制 `derived_from_downstream + needs_truth_review` | | full inconsistent package 被静默重写 | 高 | 强制 drift digest + repair route，禁止静默裁决 | | support 能力再次变重 | 中 | 复用现有 compile 能力，只新增 orchestrator 和 verdict layer | | bootstrap 输出被误认作 gate truth | 高 | verdict 只定义 requirement closure 状态，不定义 delivery completion | ## 9. 成功标准 1. `beacon-prd-bootstrap` 可以接管所有主要 partial package 状态 2. 操作者不必手动判断调用哪个 requirement 子 skill 3. 系统能显式区分： missing-layer supplement truth drift repair closure pass 4. reverse-derived truth 有显式标签 5. full inconsistent package 不会被静默重写 6. 高置信度场景可直接进入 `freeze_ready / implementation_pending` 7. 整个能力仍保持 optional support skill 定位 ## 10. 冻结结论 本 PRD 的目的是把前序 brainstorm 提出的 unified requirement closure entry 正式纳入 `v1.4.0` frozen requirement truth。 这不是新增主流程，而是对已冻结 `beacon-prd-bootstrap` support feature 的 change/refreeze 补强。 ## 11. State Machine Truth ```mermaid stateDiagram-v2 [*] --> package_detected package_detected --> missing_layer_routed: partial package found package_detected --> drift_repair_required: full inconsistent package found package_detected --> freeze_ready: full consistent package found missing_layer_routed --> reverse_derived_truth: downstream truth must be inferred reverse_derived_truth --> needs_truth_review needs_truth_review --> supplement_required: human supplement needed supplement_required --> package_detected: writeback completed drift_repair_required --> package_detected: repair route completed freeze_ready --> implementation_pending: conditional promotion accepted implementation_pending --> [*] ``` ### 11.1 State Axes `package_state`: `empty | prd_only | user_story_only | test_case_only | prd_user_story | prd_test_case | user_story_test_case | full_consistent | full_inconsistent` `closure_state`: `package_detected | missing_layer_routed | reverse_derived_truth | needs_truth_review | supplement_required | drift_repair_required | freeze_ready | implementation_pending` `truth_origin_state`: `native_truth | derived_from_downstream | needs_truth_review` `decision_state`: `accepted | rejected | deferred` `routing_state`: `canonical_compile | reverse_derive | repair_route | conditional_promotion`
